title: Consider continuing shared content while a participant hides their spatial Persona

statement.en: Consider continuing shared content while a participant hides their spatial Persona.
statement.ja: participantがspatial Personaを隠している間もshared contentの継続表示を検討する。

conditions: Ongoing content helps the participant stay informed about the shared experience.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable SharePlay experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるSharePlayの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
